scope: Complete test-scale retired instruction/data trace, no sampling. Instruction misses matched RTL when caching enabled. Padding is a trace-level estimate pending real linked-image experiments. Finite dcache is a hypothetical WB/WA LRU model with dirty evictions, not implemented RTL or measured speedup. Ideal dcache upper bound includes uncacheable accesses and is deliberately optimistic.

cache_timing.definition: Course TMT is extra miss time: miss service sum minus one measured lookup cycle per miss. Port AMAT includes uncached bypass; cacheable AMAT excludes bypass. Legacy pre-normalization reports used TMT_cycles for the inclusive miss-service sum.
